architecture_facts: yt-dlp pulls free captions first before anything is downloaded
ffmpeg extracts scene-aware frames at an auto-chosen fps
whisper transcribes the audio only when a video has no captions
near-duplicate frames are dropped by comparing grayscale thumbnails to save tokens
Claude receives the extracted frames plus a timestamped transcript
detail modes trade tokens for coverage (efficient keyframes, balanced scene-aware, token-burner uncapped)
one command installs the skill across 50+ Agent Skills hosts or as a Claude Code plugin
surprising_detail: It grabs free captions first and only pays for Whisper when a video has none, and it drops near-identical frames by comparing grayscale thumbnails so you are not spending context on ten copies of the same shot.
prompt_char_notes: The /watch invocation runs inside a Claude Code session (prompt '>'); npx install runs in a shell (prompt '$'). Terminal scene uses the shell install line so the prompt char matches.
